# Blackline 0.15.115

* **Custom emoji.** The emoji tray has a Custom section; the + tile makes one from any picture (shrunk to emoji size, under 100 KB; a small GIF stays a GIF) with a :code: you choose. Everyone you send it to sees it — the picture travels with the message. Typing :xx suggests the ten best matches, yours first. Right-click a custom tile to remove it.
